title: Checkout outage postmortem
prompt:
Write an internal postmortem for a 40-minute checkout outage on 2 March. Payments timed out because a database migration held a lock. Customers saw an error page. No data was lost. The follow-up is to add a lock timeout and a status-page update.

Requirements:
- At most 220 words.
- Use these exact markdown headings: ## Summary, ## Impact, ## Root cause, ## Follow-ups.
- State the severity.
- Describe the system failure. Do not blame a person or call anyone incompetent.
constraints: Headings: Summary, Impact, Root cause, Follow-ups
